slide1_company_intro.value: Marksans Pharma Ltd. is an Indian pharmaceutical company headquartered in Mumbai, specializing in OTC and prescription formulations across key regulated markets including the UK, US, Europe, and Australia. The company operates high-compliance manufacturing facilities and focuses on sustained backward-integrated growth in major therapeutic segments.
slide1_company_intro.source: Marksans Pharma Annual Report & Equity Research Overview

slide2_ticker.source: NSE/BSE Listed Company Directory (Marksans Pharma Ltd.)

slide2_executive_summary.value: Marksans Pharma Ltd. (NSE: MARKSANS) delivered ₹2,622.85 crore in FY25 revenue (+19.4% YoY) and ₹380.58 crore in net profit, supported by a net-cash balance sheet with ₹704.21 crore in cash and bank balances.

slide2_thesis.value: Thesis: Marksans is expanding high-margin OTC and prescription formulations across the UK, US, and Europe. With disciplined capex, negative net debt, and steady double-digit return ratios (ROE 20.35%), the company maintains a defensive growth profile.

slide2_key_highlights.value: • Revenue: ₹2,622.85 crore (+19.4% YoY); Net Profit: ₹380.58 crore (+21.6% YoY) • Cash & Bank Balances: ₹704.21 crore; Net Debt: ₹(382.30) crore (Net Cash) • Operating Cash Flow: ₹206.66 crore; Net Cash Flow: ₹92.51 crore (FY25) • EBITDA: ₹569.21 crore (21.7% Margin); WACC: 12.11% • Return on Equity (ROE): 20.35%; Return on Capital Employed (ROCE): 22.84% • International Footprint: Strong presence across UK, US, Australia, and Continental Europe

slide14_ticker.source: NSE/BSE Listed Company Directory (Marksans Pharma Ltd.)

slide14_narrative.value: Marksans Pharma's consolidated cash flow from operations reached ₹206.66 crore in FY25, supported by profit before tax of ₹503.96 crore. Net cash flow for FY25 stood at ₹92.51 crore, contributing to total cash and bank balances of ₹704.21 crore. Disciplined working capital management and steady operating margins have enabled the company to maintain a strong net-cash position while funding capacity expansion internally.

slide16_ticker.source: NSE/BSE Listed Company Directory (Marksans Pharma Ltd.)

slide16_current_ratio_narrative.value: Marksans Pharma's liquidity position remains solid, with cash and bank balances of ₹704.21 crore and net cash of ₹382.30 crore as of FY25. The company's low reliance on external working capital debt ensures robust liquidity across market cycles.

slide16_quick_ratio_narrative.value: Excluding inventories, Marksans maintains substantial liquid assets in cash, equivalents, and short-term receivables, comfortably meeting operational and debt service obligations with minimal external leverage.

slide1_business_model.value:
• Regulated Markets Focus: Strong presence across the UK, US, Australia, and Continental Europe specializing in over-the-counter (OTC) and prescription generics.
• Integrated Manufacturing: Global scale facilities in Goa, Southport (UK), and Farmingdale (US) driving high-margin solid oral and liquid dosage formulations.
slide1_business_model.source: Marksans Investor Presentation FY25 & Annual Report

slide1_brand_portfolio.value:
• Core Therapeutic Areas: Pain Management, Cough & Cold, Cardiovascular/CNS, Gastrointestinal, and Anti-diabetic formulations.
• OTC Brand Leadership: Key OTC offerings marketed under private label and store brands across major international pharmacy and retail chains.
slide1_brand_portfolio.source: Marksans Investor Presentation FY25 & Annual Report

slide1_product_ecosystem.value:
• Dosage Forms: Tablets, hard and soft gelatin capsules, oral liquids, and ointments.
• Global Compliance: US FDA, UK MHRA, and Australian TGA approved cGMP manufacturing infrastructure.
slide1_product_ecosystem.source: Marksans Annual Report FY25 & Regulatory Disclosures

slide1_strategic_approach.value: • Capacity Expansion & Forward Integration: Expanding capacity at the Teva Goa site, increasing backward API integration, and scaling direct-to-pharmacy distribution across regulated Western markets.
slide1_strategic_approach.source: Marksans Investor Presentation FY25 & Management Commentary
